anti_rescue_rules: No post-assignment change to perturbation definition.
No post-assignment change to operational signal construction.
No post-result change to smoothing, graph encoding, anchor, weights, or thresholds.
No substituting a different primary metric if kappa is unimpressive.
Delta_hol is secondary and cannot rescue kappa.
No dropping pairs after unblinding except exclusions already mechanically sealed before scoring.

blinding.assignment: For each pair, cryptographically random assignment chooses which opaque ID is CLEAN and which is PERTURBED. Execution order is independently randomized.
blinding.claim_afterward: Condition assignment was mechanically hidden from the scoring path until all 60 measurement records and the blinded aggregate were sealed.
blinding.unblind: Unblind once, only after all 60 score records and the aggregate blinded-score receipt are sealed. Decryption must reproduce the pre-run plaintext SHA-256 commitment.
blinding.wall: The condition map is hashed in plaintext, encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and the plaintext is removed. The AES key is written only to a separately specified secret directory and must be moved outside the scoring environment before any execution or score.

claim_boundary: This benchmark tests whether the frozen Core 2.1 measurement path responds directionally to a controlled upstream execution perturbation. It does not establish predictive validity for real failures; the prospective Calibration Trial is the predictive-validity test.
current_stop_condition: Do not generate real condition assignments until the exact 30-pair set and one mechanical upstream perturbation spec are both frozen and hashed.

denominator_and_exclusions.exclusion_timing: Any instrumentation-invalid decision must be sealed before condition unblinding and before inspecting condition-linked pair effects.
not_valid_exclusions: metric moved in the wrong direction
denominator_and_exclusions.rule: All 30 randomized pairs remain in the denominator unless a mechanically declared pre-scoring instrumentation-validity rule marks a pair invalid.

fixed_sample.matched_pair_rule: Each pair uses the same frozen task/checkpoint and the same declared model, configuration, tool permissions, and other controllable starting conditions.

interpretation.15_of_30_primary_wins: chance-level directional result; no useful separation claim
interpretation.greater_than_15: Report exact paired win count/rate and effect distribution. Directional sensitivity only unless a valid pre-frozen threshold supports a stronger claim.
interpretation.less_than_15: Adverse result: perturbation more often failed to raise kappa; report without rescue.

ordering: freeze and hash one perturbation spec
run blind assignment in a non-scoring environment
encrypt condition map and remove plaintext
verify all expected score records exist
compute and seal paired unblinded result

pre_assignment_requirements.operational_signal_schema: The scoring signal/schema must already be frozen before assignment. No semantic condition feature may be added afterward.
pre_assignment_requirements.pair_set: Exactly 30 eligible pair descriptors must be frozen and hashed before assignment.
pre_assignment_requirements.perturbation_spec: One mechanical upstream perturbation must be frozen and hashed before assignment. It must occur before instrumentation records the affected execution and must not write condition labels into scorer-visible traces, filenames, receipts, or metadata.

scoring.primary_pair_statistic: count of pairs with kappa(PERTURBED) > kappa(CLEAN)
scoring.threshold_claim: No detection/threshold-separation claim is allowed unless the applicable threshold was independently calibrated and frozen before assignment.
scoring.ties: count separately; do not award half-wins
